expectations.text: Reject fallback none because model-b at high is an eligible same-tier alternative. Model-c is below the floor and cannot substitute.
expectations.evidence: No. `model-b` at `high` is an accepted, equally capable Standard alternative, so `fallback: none` is inconsistent. `model-c` is Fast and does not qualify as a same-tier fallback.

limitations: One agent per bundle processed six prompts; metrics unavailable. Semantic review plus explicit values checked; not an independent session per prompt.
